_comments: THE NIGHTLY OVERLAPPING-SUBSCRIPTION CHECK (golive #279, finance exception type 5).
IT SHIPS DISABLED, like the other orders jobs, so a lower environment does not start filling the
finance review list the moment this metadata lands. It has no Preview parameter: a run only adds
review items, is idempotent per pair, and changes no order or subscription.
04:00 UTC, after the 03:00 renewal pass, so an overlap a renewal created tonight is found tonight.
The exceptions are dated to the business day, not to the UTC day the job runs on.
ConcurrencyMode Skip, MissedRunPolicy RunOnce: the check is idempotent, so a catch-up is one run.
RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun false: the first run waits for somebody to enable the job.
OwnerUserID / NotifyUserID are unset: they name people, which differ per environment.

fields.Name: Orders — Detect Overlapping Subscriptions (daily)
fields.Description: Raises a finance exception for each pair of live subscriptions for one holder whose terms overlap, for finance to confirm or correct at month end. Ships disabled: enable it once the OVERLAPPING_SUBSCRIPTION exception type is active.
